interpretation_rules: All numerical pressure and storage values are illustrative synthetic contract inputs, not South African standards, utility setpoints or a Johannesburg operating profile.
The scenario pack contains controller admission and expected-disposition requirements, not computed controller commands or measured controller performance.
Each controller receives the same initial condition, disturbance trace, direct sensor channels, sample time, actuator envelope and training-history budget within each paired comparison.
The model-free ENC publication comparator assumes direct measurement of all regulated variables; do not silently grant it qualified estimates in sparse-sensor cases.
A qualified estimator is a separate component with its own calibration, observability, uncertainty and stale-data gates. It is not supplied by a controller's self-confidence score.
A local safety interlock is independent of the supervisory controller and may have different sensors, power, logic and authority; this pack does not implement or qualify that interlock.
Controller abstention is a valid result and must be scored separately from control failure; never hide abstention in an accuracy aggregate.
No live utility SCADA connections, credentials, pump/valve commands, service allocation or emergency actions are authorized.
The 2026 ENC article's reported sample counts and compute differences are publication claims, not reproduced measurements in this repository.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic scenario design and expected-behavior contract only. No controller is implemented or qualified, and no hydraulic, hardware, safety, energy-saving or field outcome is established.
